decision_reason: No hard-bucket prediction could satisfy the frozen predictor trigger because its maximum 30 s lower edge was below the 34.683-34.791 s causal feedback budget. Feedback repeated its large JCT and makespan gains, but feedback-r2 failed the preregistered p99 TTFT bound because concurrent long-prefill requests created real tail contention. Keep feedback as a development Pareto candidate, not a tail-safe default; this result does not reject the retained Task-Aware predictor.
evidence_boundary: Development-exposed PennyLane tasks and predictions; descriptive physical evidence, not confirmation.

protocol.hardware: NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe at 250 W; 16 logical CPU cores; 94.4 GiB RAM
protocol.stop_reason: User-authorized early stop after predictor-r2 consumed all four possible loans through feedback, making the four-distinct-predictor-trigger gate unreachable. The post-outcome amendment then completed feedback-r2 and fixed-r2 without rerunning either predictor cell.

predictor_vs_feedback.interpretation: Both arms made the same four feedback-triggered loan decisions; the difference is run-to-run physical variation, not a predictor effect.

feedback_replication.tail_diagnosis: The feedback-r2 p99 increase is physical contention, not a population mismatch. Two paired long-prefill requests ran at higher overlap: PennyLaneAI__pennylane-2654 llm_47 (63,553 prompt tokens) rose from 648.444 ms at concurrency two to 1,435.925 ms at concurrency three; PennyLaneAI__pennylane-2964 llm_66 (58,318 prompt tokens) rose from 1,099.767 ms at concurrency one to 1,332.831 ms at concurrency three.

validity.tool_terminal_difference_policy: Reported but non-invalidating under the frozen fixed-trajectory protocol because tool output never changes the shadow LLM prompt.

mechanism_diagnosis.trigger_condition: predicted hard-bucket lower edge > causal feedback budget
mechanism_diagnosis.range_mismatch: The maximum possible lower edge was 30 s, so the frozen predictor condition was false for every command.
mechanism_diagnosis.opportunity_timing: For three of four foreground tasks, the first bucket-five prediction appeared only after feedback had already claimed the one-shot loan. The fourth had an earlier bucket-five prediction, but 30 s did not exceed the 34.683 s budget.
mechanism_diagnosis.preflight_failure: The label-blind carrier count checked for fifth-bucket commands but did not test the numerical trigger condition, temporal reachability while a loan remained, or the action-level utility upper bound.

decision.predictive_tool_gap_loan: NO-GO for this action mapping; do not lower the trigger or reinterpret the result post hoc.
decision.task_aware_predictor: KEEP; this experiment did not execute a predictor-triggered action and therefore is not evidence against prediction accuracy.
decision.causal_feedback: PROMISING development mechanism: one physical repetition improved mean JCT 32.748% and makespan 42.774% while p95/p99 TTFT ratios stayed below 1.05. A second fixed/feedback repetition is required before a repeated physical claim.
decision.next_gate: Before another physical run, prove offline that the prediction output can change a reachable action and that its ideal direct effect exceeds the registered minimum effect.
